lines.zh: 沙面很软，我每步都陷进去半寸。
lines.en: The dust is soft; every step sinks half an inch.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过三道沙脊，风从腿间穿过。
lines.en: One stride clears three ridges, wind threading my legs.

lines.zh: 我的脚印留不到一刻就被风抹平。
lines.en: The wind erases my prints before a moment passes.

lines.zh: 异位的风往东吹，我就往东走。
lines.en: Dustopia's wind blows east, so I walk east.

lines.zh: 沙下的震动，就是我的路。
lines.en: Vibrations under the sand are my road.

lines.zh: 干沙塞进缝隙，我抖一抖继续走。
lines.en: Dry grit fills my joints; I shake it off and go on.

lines.zh: 这条沙脊我走过百次，闭眼也认得。
lines.en: I have walked this ridge a hundred times and know it blind.

lines.zh: 我不追风，风追不上我。
lines.en: I do not chase the wind; it cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 灰从天上落，像有人在筛面粉。
lines.en: Ash falls from above as if someone sifts flour.

lines.zh: 我踩着别人的骨头走，这里到处都是。
lines.en: I walk on other people's bones; this place is full of them.

lines.zh: 走慢一点，沙下的东西会咬脚。
lines.en: Walk slower; things under the sand bite feet.

lines.zh: 我的影子在尘里拖着，很长。
lines.en: My shadow drags long through the dust.

lines.zh: 我沿着沙丘的背走，风小一些。
lines.en: I follow the dune's spine, where the wind is weaker.

lines.zh: 再多走一段，就能看见你了。
lines.en: A little farther, and I will see you.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，风把我当石头。
lines.en: I stand still and the wind takes me for stone.

lines.zh: 沙落在我背上，慢慢堆成小丘。
lines.en: Dust settles on my back and slowly becomes a hill.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等沙把我埋到膝。
lines.en: I hold still until the sand buries my knees.

lines.zh: 没有心跳，只有沙在体内流动。
lines.en: No heartbeat, only sand moving inside me.

lines.zh: 远处沙崩的声音，听起来像呼吸。
lines.en: Distant sandslides sound almost like breathing.

lines.zh: 这片空地上，只有我的影子在动。
lines.en: On this empty flat, only my shadow moves.

lines.zh: 我把头埋低，风就从背上滑过去。
lines.en: I lower my head and the wind slides off my back.

lines.zh: 安静时，我能听见沙粒互相磨。
lines.en: In the quiet I hear grains grinding together.

lines.zh: 我不睡，睡下去会被沙埋死。
lines.en: I do not sleep; sleepers get buried and die.

lines.zh: 等风停了，我才起身。
lines.en: I rise only after the wind dies.

lines.zh: 你身上没有灰，真稀奇。
lines.en: You carry no dust; that is strange.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，你走了七下。
lines.en: I counted your steps; you took seven.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，风都绕开你。
lines.en: You stand there and the wind goes around you.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛进了沙，我看见你在眨。
lines.en: Sand got in your eyes; I see you blinking.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，它们比我的慢。
lines.en: I watch your feet; they are slower than mine.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，我在异位闻过太多。
lines.en: You smell of iron; I have smelled too much of it here.

lines.zh: 别转头，我在你正后方。
lines.en: Do not turn; I am right behind you.

lines.zh: 你呼吸时胸口起伏，我记下了。
lines.en: Your chest rises as you breathe; I noted it.

lines.zh: 你站太久，沙要认得你了。
lines.en: You stand too long; the dust will learn you.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，我已经在算了。
lines.en: While you look at me, I am already measuring.

lines.zh: 你砍下来，沙从我身上掉了一块。
lines.en: You cut, and a piece of sand falls off me.

lines.zh: 疼，但疼在很远的地方。
lines.en: It hurts, but the pain feels far away.

lines.zh: 伤口在漏沙，我得快点。
lines.en: The wound leaks sand; I must hurry.

lines.zh: 你的刀不快，砍了三次才进去。
lines.en: Your blade is dull; it took three swings to bite.

lines.zh: 我比看上去更沉，你手麻了吧。
lines.en: I am heavier than I look; your hands must be numb.

lines.zh: 这一下真扎实，我记住了。
lines.en: That one was true; I will remember it.

lines.zh: 我的沙在往回收，别高兴太早。
lines.en: My sand is drawing back; do not celebrate early.

lines.zh: 五十五颗心的身体，不会因这一下倒。
lines.en: A body of fifty-five hearts will not fall to that.

lines.zh: 你打断我一条腿，我还有别的。
lines.en: You broke one leg; I have others.

lines.zh: 血？我没有血，只有灰。
lines.en: Blood? I have none, only ash.

lines.zh: 别拿面包晃，我的胃是沙做的。
lines.en: Do not wave bread; my stomach is made of sand.

lines.zh: 我不吃熟的东西，我啃石头。
lines.en: I do not eat cooked food; I chew stone.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我只想打掉。
lines.en: Whatever you hold, I only want to knock away.

lines.zh: 诱惑我？我只被跑动的东西吸引。
lines.en: Tempt me? Only moving things draw me.

lines.zh: 没有食物能让我停下脚步。
lines.en: No food can make me break stride.

lines.zh: 我不饿，异位的风就够我活着。
lines.en: I am not hungry; Dustopia's wind keeps me alive.

lines.zh: 你举着肉，我闻到的是你的手。
lines.en: You raise meat; what I smell is your hand.

lines.zh: 拿开那东西，挡着我追你了。
lines.en: Move that aside; it blocks my chase.

lines.zh: 我吞沙，不吞你的施舍。
lines.en: I swallow sand, not your charity.

lines.zh: 你再晃，我就先咬那根棍子。
lines.en: Wave it again and I bite the stick first.

lines.zh: 我的腿节太长，刹不住了，你让开。
lines.en: My leg joints are too long to brake — get out of the way.

lines.zh: 我整个身子压过去，沙从甲缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I press my whole body in and sand squeezes from my joints.

lines.zh: 我肩膀一顶，你就退了两步。
lines.en: One shove of my shoulder and you step back twice.

lines.zh: 沙子从我们之间挤出来，很响。
lines.en: Sand squeezes out between us, loudly.

lines.zh: 碰撞对我是打招呼的方式。
lines.en: Colliding is how I say hello.

lines.zh: 我贴着你走，你就跑不掉了。
lines.en: I walk against you, and you cannot get away.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲硌得我腿疼。
lines.en: Your armor digs into my legs.

lines.zh: 我不用手，我用整个身体撞。
lines.en: I have no hands; I ram with my whole body.

lines.zh: 让开，沙里没那么多空间。
lines.en: Step aside; there is not much room in the dust.

lines.zh: 异位的干沙磨着我的甲，撞你也响。
lines.en: The dry sand of the Outback grinds my shell, and it rings when I hit you.

lines.zh: 我没有伴，异位只养出我一个。
lines.en: I have no mate; Dustopia raised me alone.

lines.zh: 沙里不生小东西，只有风在滚。
lines.en: Nothing is born in this sand, only wind rolling.

lines.zh: 配对是活物的事，我早就不是了。
lines.en: Mating is for the living; I stopped being that.

lines.zh: 我找过同类，只找到一堆灰。
lines.en: I looked for my kind and found a heap of ash.

lines.zh: 两个我撞在一起，也只是一阵尘。
lines.en: Two of me colliding would only raise dust.

lines.zh: 你问这个，是打算留下来吗。
lines.en: You ask that as if you mean to stay.

lines.zh: 我没有巢，走到哪埋到哪。
lines.en: I keep no nest; I am buried wherever I stop.

lines.zh: 这地方太干，养不活第二个。
lines.en: This place is too dry to raise a second one.

lines.zh: 风把我吹散，又把我吹回来。
lines.en: The wind scatters me and blows me back.

lines.zh: 同类的味道，我记不清了。
lines.en: I can no longer recall the smell of my own kind.

lines.zh: 地上有块亮的东西，我踢开了。
lines.en: Something bright lay there; I kicked it away.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，又忘了为什么捡。
lines.en: I pick it up and forget why I did.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着的铁片，我攥了一会。
lines.en: I held a buried scrap of iron for a while.

lines.zh: 我没有口袋，东西只能含着。
lines.en: I have no pockets; I can only hold things in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这东西会响，我不喜欢响。
lines.en: This thing rattles, and I dislike rattling.

lines.zh: 你掉的，我替你踩碎了。
lines.en: You dropped it; I stepped on it for you.

lines.zh: 我捡起骨头，又放回原处。
lines.en: I picked up a bone and put it back.

lines.zh: 沉的东西我不要，跑不动。
lines.en: I do not take heavy things; they slow me.

lines.zh: 我只留能磨牙的石头。
lines.en: I keep only stones hard enough to grind my teeth.

lines.zh: 这件归我了，你别伸手。
lines.en: This is mine now; do not reach for it.

lines.zh: 你踏进沙圈，我就知道了。
lines.en: You stepped inside the sand ring, and I knew.

lines.zh: 风把你的气味送到我这边。
lines.en: The wind carried your scent over to me.

lines.zh: 我开始走了，你别跑太快。
lines.en: I have started walking; do not run too fast.

lines.zh: 我这副身子足有五十多颗心的重量。
lines.en: This body of mine carries the weight of fifty-five hearts.

lines.zh: 异位的猎手不多，我算一个。
lines.en: Dustopia has few hunters; I am one.

lines.zh: 你站在上风口，我照样闻得到。
lines.en: You stand upwind, and I still smell you.

lines.zh: 我没打算藏，我直接走过来。
lines.en: I will not hide; I am walking straight over.

lines.zh: 尘土落定的时候，你就该跑了。
lines.en: When the dust settles, that is when you should run.

lines.zh: 我一击十一点五，你算算。
lines.en: One blow of mine is eleven and a half; do the math.

lines.zh: 你打不动我，我的皮是压实的沙。
lines.en: You cannot hurt me; my hide is packed sand.

lines.zh: 追你不需要理由，只需要距离。
lines.en: Chasing you needs no reason, only distance.

lines.zh: 那边的沙脊，你过不去。
lines.en: You will not get past that ridge.

lines.zh: 我看见你的影子先动了。
lines.en: I saw your shadow move before you did.

lines.zh: 跑吧，我喜欢追着跑的东西。
lines.en: Run; I like things that run.

lines.zh: 你在异位的沙上留了脚印。
lines.en: You left prints on Dustopia's dust.

lines.zh: 这里没人跑得掉，我熟路。
lines.en: Nobody outruns me here; I know the ways.

lines.zh: 异位的沙土，磨亮了我的腿。
lines.en: The dust of this realm has polished my legs.

lines.zh: 不用回头，我一直在你后面。
lines.en: No need to look back; I am always behind you.

lines.zh: 沙面传声，你落哪只脚我都知道。
lines.en: Sound travels through the sand — I know which foot you land on.

lines.zh: 沙地上跑不快，我们都一样。
lines.en: No one runs fast on sand; we are alike there.

lines.zh: 你喘气了，我还没开始。
lines.en: You are panting; I have not started.

lines.zh: 我不用看，闻着就到了。
lines.en: I do not need to look; the scent leads me.

lines.zh: 距离在缩短，你数得到。
lines.en: The gap is closing; you can count it.

lines.zh: 你绕圈子，我就绕得更小。
lines.en: You circle, and I circle tighter.

lines.zh: 别往岩那边跑，那里更干。
lines.en: Do not run for the rocks; it is drier there.

lines.zh: 我追过跑得比你快的。
lines.en: I have chased things faster than you.

lines.zh: 你丢下的东西，我不捡。
lines.en: I will not stop for what you drop.

lines.zh: 跑动的猎物最好看。
lines.en: Running prey is the finest sight.

lines.zh: 还有十步，你听见我的脚了。
lines.en: Ten steps left; you hear my feet now.

lines.zh: 我锁定了就不改主意。
lines.en: Once I have locked on, I do not change my mind.

lines.zh: 你踩塌的沙坑会告诉我你在哪。
lines.en: The hollow you crushed tells me where you are.

lines.zh: 我不是快，我是不知道累。
lines.en: I am not fast; I simply do not tire.

lines.zh: 你和我之间只剩一口气的距离。
lines.en: Only a breath of distance stands between us.

lines.zh: 别停下，停下我就到了。
lines.en: Do not stop; stopping brings me to you.

lines.zh: 我一步跨两个你的身位。
lines.en: One stride of mine covers two of you.

lines.zh: 你回头的次数越来越少了。
lines.en: You look back less and less often.

lines.zh: 这一下，是沙里练出来的。
lines.en: This blow was practiced in the sand.

lines.zh: 你退得对，我还会再来。
lines.en: You step back rightly; I will come again.

lines.zh: 我的手臂像一根夯土桩。
lines.en: My arm comes down like a rammed-earth post.

lines.zh: 打中了，我听见沉闷的一声。
lines.en: It landed, and I heard a dull, heavy sound.

lines.zh: 十一半的力气，全给你。
lines.en: Eleven and a half of force, all for you.

lines.zh: 沙脊上我一个跨步就到了。
lines.en: One stride across the sand ridge and I am there.

lines.zh: 我不换招，我只加快。
lines.en: I do not change my move; I only speed it up.

lines.zh: 你的盾在抖，我看见了。
lines.en: Your shield trembles, and I have seen it.

lines.zh: 这一击扬起沙子，正好迷你的眼。
lines.en: The blow kicks up sand, right into your eyes.

lines.zh: 我打得慢，但每下都实在。
lines.en: I strike slowly, but every hit is solid.

lines.zh: 别退到沙坑里，那里更糟。
lines.en: Do not back into the pit; it is worse there.

lines.zh: 我不用武器，这副身子就是。
lines.en: I need no weapon; this body is one.

lines.zh: 你身上开始有血味了。
lines.en: The smell of blood is starting on you.

lines.zh: 站着别动，第二下要来了。
lines.en: Stand still; the second blow is coming.

lines.zh: 沙压成的拳头砸下来，没有回声。
lines.en: My sand-packed fist falls without an echo.

lines.zh: 这一下落在你举盾的腕子上。
lines.en: This blow lands on the wrist that holds your shield.

lines.zh: 我不换招，我只补第二下。
lines.en: I do not feint; I only add the second blow.

lines.zh: 你被砸退半步，沙吃掉了脚跟。
lines.en: The hit pushes you back; sand swallows your heels.

lines.zh: 我抖下的尘土糊了你的眼。
lines.en: Dust shaken from my body pastes your eyes shut.

lines.zh: 这拳落下时，风先散开。
lines.en: When this fist falls, the air scatters first.

lines.zh: 沙堆塌下一角，我从中站起来。
lines.en: A corner of the dune collapsed, and I stood out of it.

lines.zh: 风停了，我才被放出来。
lines.en: The wind stopped, and only then was I let out.

lines.zh: 异位又把一个我推到地表。
lines.en: Dustopia pushed another of me to the surface.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的沙，慢慢成形。
lines.en: I shook off the sand and slowly took shape.

lines.zh: 这片沙地空了太久，该有东西走了。
lines.en: This flat lay empty too long; something should walk it.

lines.zh: 我从干裂的地缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeezed up through a crack in the dried ground.

lines.zh: 没有声音，我只是出现了。
lines.en: There was no sound; I simply appeared.

lines.zh: 沙里的骨头动了，我借它站起来。
lines.en: Bones in the sand stirred, and I borrowed them to rise.

lines.zh: 又一个猎手醒了，你们小心。
lines.en: Another hunter has woken; be careful.

lines.zh: 我出生就知道该往哪走。
lines.en: I knew where to walk the moment I was born.

lines.zh: 尘土为我一层层聚起来。
lines.en: The dust gathered layer by layer to make me.

lines.zh: 这地方需要有人巡逻。
lines.en: This place needs someone to patrol it.

lines.zh: 我落地时没有影子。
lines.en: When I settled, I cast no shadow.

lines.zh: 风把我吹成现在这样。
lines.en: The wind blew me into what I am now.

lines.zh: 火把沙烧成硬壳，我动不了了。
lines.en: Fire fuses the sand to crust; I can barely move.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，我碎成一片沙雾。
lines.en: Falling from height, I burst into a spray of sand.

lines.zh: 水一泡，我就沉成一堆泥。
lines.en: In water I sink into a heap of mud.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹散，我又慢慢聚回。
lines.en: The blast scatters me; I gather myself back.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我身上，像插进沙里。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in me the way it sticks in sand.

lines.zh: 药水的味道让我的沙结块。
lines.en: The potion's smell makes my sand clump.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但我会变干。
lines.en: I do not eat, but I do dry out.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的一部分变成了玻璃。
lines.en: Lightning struck, and part of me turned to glass.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有沙，我在那里散开。
lines.en: There is no sand in the void; I come apart there.
